purpose: Test whether local parametric photographic retouching gives useful lighting and material appearance without REGEN's game-to-photo reconstruction artifacts.
input_contract: Captured display-referred RGB including HUD. No normals, depth, motion, material labels or paired photographic ground truth.
order: Run unchanged author model and checkpoint on CPU; inspect all raw outputs.
Only if raw output has useful appearance, try fixed-shape DirectML export with independent CPU parity and transfer-inclusive timing.
Only after spatial acceptance, evaluate consecutive frames and bounded full-resolution composition before native integration.
rejection: Reject lost opening/foliage contrast, altered material identity, new texture artifacts or worse appearance. Reduced blend strength alone does not establish substantial improvement.
scope: Candidate evaluation, not complete application performance. The existing working companion remains available.
